title: Dunn
creator: CrossFit
description: A 19-minute AMRAP of 3 muscle-ups, a 5-10-15 yard shuttle sprint and 6 burpee box jump-overs on a 20 in box without touching it. Honours U.S. Marine Lance Cpl. Kielin Dunn, killed in Helmand Province, Afghanistan, in 2010. Scale muscle-ups to chest-to-bar pull-ups.
